name: Fragments Of Eden
source: Bruce Hayden, wannabe novelist, with a luck so bad, he may get struck by the same lighting bolt three times in a row. A ghost town mystery with a collection of comically silly characters.
translation: 布鲁斯·海登一心想当小说家，可他背到什么程度呢？同一道闪电都可能连着劈中他三次。一个发生在鬼镇的悬疑故事，登场的是一群傻得好笑的角色。
